title: Grab 1.54TB free cloud storage for life — but you will need to sign up to 43 services
excerpt: No strings attached, but you need to subscribe to and maintain more than 40 services
content_html:
As of August 2026, there are 43 free cloud storage providers offering a combined capacity of almost 1.54TB.

The majority of these providers are based in Europe and offer capacities ranging from a few hundred MB to a staggering 1.02 TB.

Terabox exceeds the capacity of most paid cloud storage services but has some serious restrictions (but then again, 1TB...).

Against all odds, there are more free cloud storage providers than three years ago. This is bucking a trend (free web hosting services numbers are going down) and is in spite of more intense competition from hyperscalers (including Facebook) as well as increasing operational costs (hello Ram-geddon).

Over the past five years, dozens of cloud storage companies have either given up on free cloud storage (e.g Samsung, Amazon and Ionos) or closed shop altogether (e.g. Flipdrive, Ganso).

What you may end up needing is a cloud storage management service to aggregate all your cloud storage, presenting you with a unified interface. You won’t find any free ones as bandwidth is costly, which explains why a few services listed here have bandwidth restrictions (Icedrive, for example, has a 3GB per day limit).

For this article, we’ve selected free cloud storage providers that do offer totally free unrestricted access to their services: so no trial e.g. try free for 90 days.

content_html_zh:
截至 2026 年 8 月，有 43 个免费云存储提供商提供的总容量接近 1.54TB。

这些提供商大多数位于欧洲，提供的容量范围从几百 MB 到惊人的 1.02 TB。

Terabox 超过了大多数付费云存储服务的容量，但有一些严格的限制（但话又说回来，1TB...）。

尽管困难重重，免费云存储提供商的数量比三年前还要多。 这与趋势相反（免费网络托管服务数量正在下降），尽管来自超大规模提供商（包括 Facebook）的竞争更加激烈，而且运营成本不断增加（你好，Ram-geddon）。

在过去的五年里，数十家云存储公司要么放弃了免费云存储（例如三星、亚马逊和 Ionos），要么干脆关门大吉（例如 Flipdrive、Ganso）。

您最终可能需要的是云存储管理服务来聚合所有云存储，为您提供统一的界面。 你找不到任何免费的服务，因为带宽成本很高，这解释了为什么这里列出的一些服务有带宽限制（例如，Icedrive 每天有 3GB 的限制）。

在本文中，我们选择了免费的云存储提供商，它们确实提供完全免费、无限制的服务访问：因此无需试用，例如免费试用 90 天。
